So `isDataValid` checks `dataLen >= sizeof(tcphdr)` and `dataLen >= hdr->dataOffset * 4`. So the TCP layer is only created if the data is at least `sizeof(tcphdr)` bytes. So `computeCalculateFields` writing `headerChecksum` (2 bytes at offset 16) would be within bounds.
